original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日尔军方称兵变后“逐步恢复控制”
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日尔军方表示，在首都尼亚美国际机场附近一处军事基地发生兵变后，正“逐步恢复控制”。国防部长萨利富·莫迪将军在声明中称，一群违反军规的士兵试图扣押战友并开枪，但安全部队迅速反应，已控制局势。目前事件细节尚未完全证实，且仅有单一来源报道。

location.raw_text: a military base near the international airport in Niamey

key_facts.fact: 尼日尔军方称在尼亚美军事基地兵变后逐步恢复控制
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Niger's military 'gradually regaining control' after mutiny at military base

key_facts.fact: 兵变士兵在尼亚美101号基地试图扣押战友并开枪
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a group of soldiers acting in breach of military regulations attempted to detain some of their comrades at the Base 101 barracks in Niamey and opened fire on several sensitive sites in the city

key_facts.fact: 国防部长萨利富·莫迪呼吁公众保持冷静
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: authorities called on the public to "remain calm and freely go about their business."
